tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that deliver to, or offer pickup near, a US location. Returns restaurant_id, cuisines, distance when a street address is given, Yelp rating when one is on file, and the restaurant page URL. Ask for a ZIP code, city and state, or street address before calling if you do not already have it.

location.description: ZIP code, 'City, ST', or a full US street address (best: gives distances).

query.description: Cuisine, dish or restaurant name, e.g. 'thai', 'pizza', 'pad see ew'. Omit for everything nearby.

catering.description: True to search caterers (has_catering). Omit or false for ordinary restaurants, which hides catering-only businesses.

tools.name: search_caterers
tools.description: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that offer catering near a US location. Same results as search_restaurants with catering true. Use this for office meals, platters, and catering orders. Returns restaurant_id values get_menu can open with menu_type "catering".

location.description: ZIP code, 'City, ST', or a full US street address (best: gives distances).

query.description: Cuisine, dish or restaurant name. Omit for every caterer nearby.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Get a restaurant's BringMeThat menu: sections, items with item_id, descriptions, prices, and option groups (including which ones are required). Prices are item prices; checkout adds the fees create_checkout_link describes. Use restaurant_id from search_restaurants. Pass menu_type "catering" for the separate catering menu (it does not replace the regular menu). Items without a published catering price say "Price on request". Large menus can be narrowed with section or search.

menu_type.description: regular is the restaurant menu. catering is the separate catering menu at menus/catering/{id}.json.

section.description: Only sections whose name contains this, e.g. 'noodles'.

search.description: Only items whose name or description contains this, e.g. 'vegetarian'.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Price a cart the way BringMeThat checkout will show it: item total, fees, tax, delivery or pickup, and the default tip. Does not charge a card, does not place an order, and does not create a link. Pass the same restaurant_id, fulfillment, and items you will pass to create_checkout_link. The quote is the guest total. The Premium checkbox keeps its default and is not changed by this tool. Checkout is the item total plus a 10% markup, the restaurant's own service fee (none for partner restaurants; there is no flat service fee), tax, a $7 delivery fee ($0 for pickup) unless a Habitat or MealMe delivery quote replaces it, and an optional tip. Premium ($9.95/month or $96/year) waives the markup and the service fee, but not delivery, tax, or tip. The card is authorized for that total plus $15 when the total is over $30, otherwise plus 45%. Only the final amount is charged.

delivery_address.description: Street address for delivery. Not required to quote.

options.description: Choices for the item's option groups. Use group_index and option names exactly as get_menu lists them. Required groups must be filled.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Build a bringmethat.com checkout link for the customer's items. Opening checkout_url fills their cart and opens bringmethat.com checkout, where they review the total and pay. No account is required. Does not charge a card and does not place the order. Validates items and required options first and returns quote plus checkout_url, or the problems to fix with the customer. Optional customer_name, customer_email, and customer_phone prefill guest checkout. Never ask for a card number. Checkout is the item total plus a 10% markup, the restaurant's own service fee (none for partner restaurants; there is no flat service fee), tax, a $7 delivery fee ($0 for pickup) unless a Habitat or MealMe delivery quote replaces it, and an optional tip. Premium ($9.95/month or $96/year) waives the markup and the service fee, but not delivery, tax, or tip. The card is authorized for that total plus $15 when the total is over $30, otherwise plus 45%. Only the final amount is charged.

delivery_address.description: Street address for delivery, e.g. '2415 N Ashland Ave, Chicago, IL 60614'. Prefills checkout.

customer_name.description: Customer name. Prefills guest checkout. Does not create an account.

customer_email.description: Email for the receipt. Prefills guest checkout. Use the same email with get_order_status.

options.description: Choices for the item's option groups. Use group_index and option names exactly as get_menu lists them. Required groups must be filled.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the status of a BringMeThat order, including a guest order that is still being placed. Does not change the order. Needs the order number (starts with R) and the email used at checkout; details are returned only when both match.

tools.name: get_premium_signup_link
tools.description: Get the link where a customer can join BringMeThat Premium ($9.95/month or $96/year), which removes the 10% markup and the restaurant service fee from every order. Returns the signup URL, prices and what is included. Does not charge a card and does not start a subscription; the customer signs up and pays on bringmethat.com.
